review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities: Design and deploy end-to-end Cisco SD-Access fabrics, separating the physical underlay (typically built with IS-IS or BGP) from the virtual overlay (using VXLAN and LISP). Administer Cisco Catalyst Center for zero-touch provisioning, network orchestration, telemetry, and assurance. Troubleshoot routing, switching, wireless, VLANs, network segmentation, and connectivity issues. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, implementation plans, test plans, and as-built diagrams.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 8+ years of enterprise networking experience with deep hands-on focus on Cisco Catalyst 9000 series switches, Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers, Cisco SDA, and Cisco DNA Center. Hands-on experience with Cisco DNA Center (Catalyst Center) for network management, automation, and orchestration. Hands-on experience with Cisco ACI, Meraki, and Fortinet switching and wireless technologies.
